clue.text: Silly person lacking emotion, but twisted inside?

indicators.note: twisted inside says only the inner letters of the word are turned round, the outer ones staying put

parts.note: someone lacking emotion is cold

explanation.surface: A remark about an unfeeling fool who is secretly a bit warped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twisted inside' turns the middle pair OL of COLD round to LO, leaving C and D in place.
explanation.definitionFit: A clod is a dull, stupid person, a blockhead.

clue.text: Where maximum individual contribution is now £5?

definitions.text: Where maximum individual contribution is now £5?

parts.words: Where maximum individual contribution is now £5?
parts.note: read as the coins in your pocket, where the biggest single coin is now worth five pounds

explanation.surface: A charity or political fund capping each donation at five pounds.
explanation.walkthrough: A five-pound coin had been issued, so the most any one piece of the cash in your pocket can be worth is £5.
explanation.definitionFit: Loose change is coins carried in the pocket, each coin an individual piece.

clue.text: Type of chess opening in which queen is given respect

indicators.note: in which says the queen is put inside the opening named

parts.note: a defence, such as the Sicilian, is a type of chess opening
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: In a particular chess opening, the queen is treated with respect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is given' is only a link. 'queen' tempts you towards the chess piece, but crosswords often use ER, the royal cipher of Elizabeth Regina, for queen.
explanation.definitionFit: Deference is polite submission and respect shown to someone.

clue.text: Bishop has three letters duplicated by accountant

definitions.text: Bishop has three letters duplicated by accountant

parts.words: Bishop has three letters duplicated by accountant
parts.note: read as a description of a word for an accountant that starts with B (bishop) and has three doubled letters in a row

explanation.surface: A churchman's correspondence gets copied by the diocesan finance officer.
explanation.walkthrough: The word starts with B, the chess abbreviation for bishop, and contains three consecutive pairs of doubled letters, which is the famous oddity the clue describes.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who keeps a firm's accounts is a book-keeper, a junior kind of accountant.

clue.text: Mistakes marked by at least three catcalls

parts.note: a boo is one catcall, and boos two or more more, so together at least three
a boo is one catcall, and boos two or more more, so together at least three

explanation.surface: Errors greeted by a chorus of jeers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'marked by' is a link. One boo plus several boos makes at least three catcalls.
explanation.definitionFit: Boo-boos is informal for blunders or silly mistakes.

clue.text: Essential computer facility for surgical procedure?

definitions.meaning: the core software that runs a computer, such as Windows
whimsically, a method of carrying out operations in a hospital

explanation.definitionFit: Software like Windows or Linux is an operating system; a surgeon's way of operating could whimsically be called one too.

clue.text: In pocket, one can afford security devices

definitions.text: In pocket, one can afford security devices

parts.words: In pocket, one can afford security devices
parts.note: read not as being rich but as an item kept in the pocket that holds keys, the security devices

explanation.surface: Someone flush with money can buy burglar alarms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In pocket' and 'afford' suggest having money; 'afford' means provide, and the security devices are keys.
explanation.definitionFit: A key ring is a loop that carries keys, kept in a pocket.

clue.text: Rice dish somewhat unusual? I perked up

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the letters are read from bottom to top
somewhat says only part of the words that follow is used

explanation.surface: A diner finds a rice dish rather odd and brightens up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somewhat' takes UALIP from 'unusual? I perked'; 'up' then reads it backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Pilau is rice cooked in stock with spices, often with meat or vegetables.

clue.text: Sectarian taking up one particular emperor?

definitions.text: Sectarian taking up one particular emperor?

parts.words: Sectarian taking up one particular emperor?
parts.note: a member of a sect that venerates a single emperor, Haile Selassie of Ethiopia

explanation.surface: A sect member adopting the cause of a certain monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: The movement takes its name from Ras Tafari, Haile Selassie's name before he became emperor.
explanation.definitionFit: A Rastafarian, who reveres Haile Selassie, is called by this short form.

clue.text: Male cat meets sweet queen, beginning to yowl for hanky panky

parts.note: a tom is a male cat
a fool is a fruit-and-cream pudding, a British dessert
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen

indicators.note: beginning to says only the opening letter of the next word is taken

explanation.surface: A tomcat courting a lovely female and starting to caterwaul is up to no good.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sweet' misleads as an adjective for the queen cat; it is the noun FOOL, a British pudding of fruit folded into cream.
explanation.definitionFit: Hanky-panky is silly or mischievous behaviour, the same as foolishness or tomfoolery.

clue.text: Bonus luxury finally withdrawn

indicators.note: finally withdrawn says the final letter of the word is taken away

parts.note: plush means luxurious, used here for luxury

explanation.surface: A perk of luxury that is eventually taken away.
explanation.definitionFit: A plus is an advantage or extra benefit, much as a bonus is.

clue.text: Oddball worried about being heartless

indicators.note: about here means moved around, so the letters left are rearranged
being heartless says the middle letter of the word is cut out

explanation.surface: Someone anxious about losing all compassion is considered peculiar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being heartless' removes the central R of WORRIED, leaving WORIED; 'about' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: An oddball is an eccentric, strange person, which is what a weirdo is.

clue.text: Local birds, given mostly unfair treatment, getting in a state?

indicators.note: this word is a container marker: it says one piece is placed inside the other, and the clue words of the pieces show which way round

parts.note: VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia

indicators.note: treatment suggests the letters are worked on and rearranged
mostly says the word loses its last letter

explanation.surface: Native wild birds are being treated unjustly, and the matter is causing a fuss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting in a state' sounds like panic, but it tells you to put the shuffled letters inside A plus a US state abbreviation. 'mostly' cuts the last letter off 'unfair'.
explanation.definitionFit: Avifauna is the collective term for the bird life of a particular region.

clue.text: The state of Bismarck's leadership?

parts.note: not the German chancellor's rule but the US state whose capital city is Bismarck

explanation.surface: A question about how well the German chancellor Bismarck led his country.
explanation.walkthrough: Bismarck is the capital of a US state, so it 'leads' it.
explanation.definitionFit: Bismarck is the state capital of North Dakota.

clue.text: Avoid attention in the army

definitions.meaning: to keep away from someone deliberately

explanation.definitionFit: To shun is to avoid; 'shun is the drill sergeant's short form of the command attention.

clue.text: Type of jazz/rock group making an entrance

parts.note: swing is a style of big-band jazz
the Doors were an American rock band

explanation.surface: A jazz-rock band bursting onto the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Doors that swing both ways form an entrance, as in a saloon or kitchen.

clue.text: Reveal don's problem — having too much on

indicators.note: a problem leaves things in a muddle, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An academic exposes his trouble with overwork.
explanation.walkthrough: 'problem' looks like the don's trouble but signals rearranging REVEALDON.
explanation.definitionFit: Something overladen carries too heavy a load.

clue.text: Reaching some lowish joints, — for some shorts, perhaps

definitions.text: Reaching some lowish joints, — for some shorts, perhaps

parts.words: Reaching some lowish joints, — for some shorts, perhaps
parts.note: the lowish joints are the knees, and some shorts come down as far as them

explanation.surface: A description of how far a pair of shorts hangs down the leg.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothing that ends at the knee is described by this length term, as with Bermuda shorts.

clue.text: Record one's poem as part of a series

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record
one's gives I, the Roman numeral one, plus S
an ode is a lyric poem

explanation.surface: Recording one's own poetry as one instalment of a set.
explanation.definitionFit: An episode is one instalment of a broadcast serial.

clue.text: Expert shown stolen photo

parts.note: hot is slang for stolen goods
a shot is a photograph

explanation.surface: A specialist is shown a picture of loot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shown' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A hotshot is a highly skilled, successful person.

clue.text: Mobile police unit's confirmation that E is involved

definitions.text: Mobile police unit's confirmation that E is involved

parts.words: Mobile police unit's confirmation that E is involved
parts.note: a patrol car radioing in uses the phonetic alphabet word for the letter E

explanation.surface: A patrol car crew confirming over the radio that a suspect called E is implicated.
explanation.definitionFit: In the NATO phonetic alphabet used on police radio, the codeword for E is this word.

clue.text: Doggedly pursuing decimal basis for each urban area

parts.note: the decimal system is based on ten
a, as in 'ten pence a go', means for each
a city is a large urban area

explanation.surface: Someone stubbornly chasing the base-ten rule for every town.
explanation.definitionFit: Persistence in doggedly pursuing a goal is tenacity.

clue.text: The last one to announce judgement

definitions.text: The last one to announce judgement

parts.words: The last one to announce judgement
parts.note: the biblical last horn blast that heralds the Day of Judgement, or a card game's last winning card

explanation.surface: Describing the person who finally pronounces a verdict.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'last trump' is the trumpet call that announces Judgement Day in the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: A trump is an old word for a trumpet; the last trump sounds at Judgement Day.

clue.text: Nearly time — it's late

parts.note: nigh means near or nearly

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that it is almost time and getting late.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the phrase 'it's late': the hours of darkness are a late time of day.
explanation.definitionFit: The dark hours after evening are what we mean by a late time, so the phrase points to that period.

clue.text: Publicity called for the star to leave husband

indicators.note: to leave says the letter named must go out of the phrase before it

parts.note: the lead is the star role in a play or film

explanation.surface: An actress is being urged to walk out on her spouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'called for' joins the definition to the wordplay; H drops out of THE LEAD, leaving a television advertisement.
explanation.definitionFit: A tele-ad is a television advertisement, a piece of publicity.

clue.text: Egg flip for half of regulars?

indicators.note: flip means toss over, so the letters are turned into a new order
half of says only the front half of the word is used

explanation.surface: A request for an egg flip, a frothy drink, for half the bar's regulars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Egg flip' looks like the drink; 'Egg' is the verb definition and 'flip' rearranges REGU, the first half of REGULARS.
explanation.definitionFit: To egg someone on is to urge them, to spur them to act.

clue.text: The door can have adjustment, to be made solid

indicators.note: an adjustment rearranges things, so these letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A door is fixed so that it is sturdy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'solid' looks like describing the door, but it names a geometric figure.
explanation.definitionFit: An octahedron is a solid figure with eight faces.

clue.text: Article read in bed about hard wood used as sun-shield

indicators.note: in places the article inside the word for bed

parts.note: pit is slang for bed

indicators.note: about places the article around the pieces that follow

parts.note: the is the definite article
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
elm is a kind of wood

explanation.surface: A newspaper item read in bed concerning hardwood used for shade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'read' is just a link here. Pit is British slang for bed, and the article wraps hard wood before both go into the bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A pith helmet is a lightweight tropical hat worn to shield the head from the sun.

clue.text: Number expressed surprise, seeing patriarch

parts.note: ah is an exclamation of surprise

explanation.surface: A figure gasped in astonishment on seeing the head of the family.
explanation.definitionFit: Noah, who built the ark, is one of the Old Testament patriarchs.
